text: Santa has one night. Physics says it could cost him twenty-three years.
Midnight to six. Nearly eight hundred kilometres a second.
Now push him close to the speed of light.
The faster you move, the slower your clock ticks.
One second for him is nine hours at home.
He lives one night. The North Pole lives twenty-three years.
He lands at six in the morning. Right on time.
For him, it was one night. For her, it was a lifetime.
